info.name: Group 10: Financial Management System — Enterprise & HRMS Integration API
info.description:
Comprehensive M2M integration collection for Group 10 (Financial Management System - Transaction Core) supporting the HRMS Cluster Protocol (HR1–HR4), ESFA Group 3 (E-Commerce), Supply Chain, Fleet, and Facilities.

### Authentication
All requests use either the `X-API-KEY` header or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Pre-configured via collection variable `{{api_key}}`.

### Environments
- Local: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`
- Production: Set `{{base_url}}` to your live deployed domain.

item.name: 1. HRMS Cluster (HR1–HR4)
item.description: Integration endpoints conforming to Section 3 and Section 4 of the official HRMS Cluster Outline (Flow #15 & #18). Supports batch { records: [] } payloads up to 500 rows, centavos auto-conversion, and idempotent upserts.

request.description: HR4 batch payroll disbursement ingestion. Accepts up to 500 rows. Auto-converts centavos to PHP decimal. Deduplicates via payroll_run_id + employee_code.
HR4 employee medical and reimbursement claims. Creates ApBill and queues PaymentRequest.
HR3 (Group 1: PDMS) training cost reimbursement and monetary recognition awards.
Returns allocated budget, total spent, remaining balance, and utilization rate for department.
Track payment request approval and check release status for an external reference.
